content.zekr_english: In Your Name, O Allah, I die and I live.
content.bless_english: A reminder that death and life are in Allah's hands.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, in Your Name I lay my side down, and in Your Name I raise it. If You take my soul, then have mercy upon it, and if You send it back, then protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma bismika wada'tu janbee, wa bika arfa'uhu, in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfazhaa bimaa tahfazu bihi 'ibaadakas-saaliheen.
content.bless_english: Protection for the soul during sleep.

content.zekr_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ.
content.zekr_english: All praise is for Allah Who fed us and quenched our thirst, and sufficed us and gave us refuge. For how many are there who have no one to suffice them and no one to give them refuge!
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee at'amanaa wa saqaanaa, wa kafaanaa wa aawaanaa, fakam mimman laa kaafiya lahu wa laa mu'wiya.
content.bless_english: Praise and gratitude to Allah for His blessings.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, our Lord and the Lord of everything, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah and the Injeel (Gospel) and the Furqan (Qur'an), I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything You will seize by its forelock. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; and You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; and You are the Manifest, so there is nothing above You; and You are the Intimate, so there is nothing beyond You. Settle our debt for us and enrich us from poverty.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Rabbanaa wa Rabba kulli shay'in, faaliqal-habbi wannaawaa, wa munzilat-Tawraati wal-Injeeli wal-Furqaan, a'oodhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in Anta aakhidhun binaasiyatihi, Allaahumma Antal-Awwalu falaysa qablaka shay'un, wa Antal-Aakhiru falaysa ba'daka shay'un, wa Antadh-Dhaahiru falaysa fawqaka shay'un, wa Antal-Baatinu falaysa doonaka shay'un, iqdi 'annad-dayna wa aghninaa minal-faqr.
content.bless_arabic: دعاء جامع لطلب الحماية، قضاء الدين، والغنى.
content.bless_english: A comprehensive supplication seeking protection, debt settlement, and richness.

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ. لاَ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ. وَلاَ أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ. وَلاَ أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَا عَبَدْتُّمْ. وَلاَ أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ. لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshipers of what I worship. Nor will I be a worshiper of what you have worshiped. Nor will you be worshipers of what I worship. For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon. Laa a'budu maa ta'budoona. Wa laa antum 'aabidoona maa a'bud. Wa laa anaa 'aabidum maa 'abattum. Wa laa antum 'aabidoona maa a'bud. Lakum deenukum wa liya deen.
content.bless_english: It is equivalent to a quarter of the Qur'an and negates polytheism.
content.source: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/205, graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (Mentioned for sleeping after reading it).

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
content.bless_arabic: دعاء للحماية من عذاب القبر وعذاب النار.
content.bless_english: A supplication for protection from the torment of the grave and the Hellfire.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/311, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/466. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, I have submitted my face to You, and entrusted my affair to You, and committed my back to You, out of desire and fear of You. There is no refuge or escape from You except to You. I have believed in Your Book which You revealed, and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma aslamtu wajhee ilayka, wa fawwadtu amree ilayka, wa alja'tu dhahree ilayka raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka, laa malja'a wa laa manjaa minka illaa ilayka, aamantu bikitaabikal-ladhee anzalta, wa bi Nabiyyikal-ladhee arsalta.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها ثم مات من ليلته كان على الفطرة.
content.bless_english: Whoever says this and then dies that night, he dies upon the natural disposition of Islam (fitra).

content.zekr_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33 مرة) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33 مرة) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (34 مرة).
content.zekr_english: Glory be to Allah (33 times), All praise is for Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Subhaanallaah (33 times), Alhamdulillah (33 times), Allaahu Akbar (34 times).

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
content.zekr_english: Allah! There is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and He is not wearied by their preservation. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu laa ta'khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawmun lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi man thal-lathee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi'ithnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona bishay'in min 'ilmihi illaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-arda wa laa ya'ooduhu hifthuhumaa wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
content.bless_arabic: من قرأها في ليلة لم يزل عليه من الله حافظ، ولا يقربه شيطان حتى يصبح.
content.bless_english: Whoever recites it at night, a guardian from Allah will remain with him, and no devil will approach him until morning.

content.zekr_arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ. لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ.
content.zekr_english: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they say, 'We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the destination.' Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what it has incurred. 'Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minoon, kullun aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin mir-rusulihi wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaykal-maseer. Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alayhaa mak-tasabat Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa Anta Mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
content.bless_arabic: من قرأ الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه.
content.bless_english: Whoever recites the two verses from the end of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will be sufficient for him.

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul Huwallaahu Ahad. Allaahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakullahu kufuwan ahad.
content.bless_english: They will suffice you against everything.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/567. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (To be recited with Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas).

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created; And from the evil of darkness when it settles; And from the evil of the blowers in knots; And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul a'oothu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin ithaa waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathaati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin ithaa hasad.
content.bless_english: They will suffice you against everything.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/567. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (To be recited with Surah Al-Ikhlas and An-Nas).

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul a'oothu bi Rabbin-naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas. Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal-jinnati wannaas.
content.bless_english: They will suffice you against everything.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/567. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (To be recited with Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Falaq).

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord of everything and its Sovereign, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, and from the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and from committing any evil against myself, or bringing it upon a Muslim.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal-ardi, 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekahu, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Anta, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkihi, wa an aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, aw ajurrahul ilaa Muslim.
content.bless_arabic: دعاء للحماية من شر النفس والشيطان.
content.bless_english: A supplication for protection from the evil of one's soul and Satan.
content.source: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/467, Sunan Abu Dawud 4/317. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ، وَكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ تَكْشِفُ الْمَغْرَمَ وَالْمَأْثَمَ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ يُهْزَمُ جُنْدُكَ، وَلاَ يُخْلَفُ وَعْدُكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your Noble Face and Your Perfect Words from the evil of that which You seize by its forelock. O Allah, You remove debt and sin. O Allah, Your army is not defeated, and Your promise is not broken. Glory and praise be to You.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu biwajhikal-Kareem, wa kalimaatikat-taammah, min sharri maa Anta aakhidhun binaasiyatihi, Allaahumma Anta takshiful-maghrama wal-ma'thama, Allaahumma laa yuhzamu junduka, wa laa yukhlifu wa'duka, subhaanaka wa bihamdika.
content.bless_english: Seeking protection and removal of debts and sins.
content.source: Abu Dawud (from Hisn al-Muslim, general context for protection).

content.zekr_arabic: الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
content.zekr_english: Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Alladhee laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu, wa atoobu ilayh.
content.source: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/569, Sunan Abu Dawud 2/85. (Part of a longer Hadith about repentance).

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَأَذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قَلْبِي وَأَجِرْنِي مِنَ مُضِلاَتِ الْفِتَنِ مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, Lord of Prophet Muhammad, forgive my sin, remove the rage from my heart, and protect me from misleading trials as long as You keep me alive.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbin-Nabiyyi Muhammadin ighfir lee dhanbee wa adhhib ghayza qalbee wa ajirnee minal-mudillaatil-fitani maa abqaytanee.
content.bless_arabic: دعاء لطلب المغفرة وسلامة القلب من الفتن.
content.bless_english: A supplication for seeking forgiveness and a sound heart from trials.
content.source: Musnad Ahmad 6/154 (part of a longer Hadith, mentioned in Hisn al-Muslim for general supplication).
